entities.summary: Luke Witkowski is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for Brynäs IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He has previously played in the NHL for the Tampa Bay Lightning and the Detroit Red Wings. Witkowski was selected by the Lightning, 160th overall, in the 2008 NHL entry draft.
